(2) The drummer smiles and nods her head to the beat, displaying energetic facial expressions. She performs a series of rapid rolls on the snare and crashes on the brass cymbals. The background lighting consists of bright, cool-toned artificial lights from surrounding buildings and street lamps. (3) The camera captures a medium shot showing her full body movement; she swivels her torso and extends her arms to reach different cymbals. A blue rolling suitcase and several passersby are stationary or walking slowly behind her on the wet-looking pavement. (4) The drummer executes a visual flourish by pointing her drumstick toward the sky between beats. She maintains a high-arousal performance style, with her mouth occasionally mimicking the rhythm. (5) The performance concludes with a final series of heavy strikes on the cymbals and a final pose as she looks toward the camera with a wide grin.
